# Lightning session F: Media

Day 2, 14:00 · a community speaker, Patrick Domanico · lightning · coverage: transcript

Two community talks, captured by a second attendee recording: rewriting image alt text with an LLM through a crawler (speaker not named) and 'prompt journalism' (Patrick Domanico, Technical SEO Manager & Freelance Journalist, dentsu: hand-over 'Patrick', the only Patrick on the official speaker list).

## Claims

- **[Stage]** Version 20 of the Screaming Frog SEO Spider, released in May 2024, was the first that could connect the crawler to ChatGPT through custom JavaScript, which let SEOs rewrite image alt text at scale.
  <br><sub>`D2-C946` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (speaker not identified) · not in Google docs</sub>

- **[Stage]** In a community speaker's case, an LLM asked to write alt text for a product image of a veterinary anxiety medicine for cats described only what it could see, a cat and a veterinarian, and dropped the stress, anxiety and medical-treatment intent of the page.
  <br><sub>`D2-C947` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (speaker not identified) · Extends [D2-C462](D2-S12-what-is-structured-data-and-why-we-need-it-on-the-internet.md)</sub>

- **[Stage]** After shipping LLM-rewritten image alt text on a client's site, a community speaker saw the site's image performance in Google Search Console drop (no figures were given).
  <br><sub>`D2-C948` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (speaker not identified)</sub>

- **[Stage]** To test LLM-generated alt text before a rollout, a community speaker recommended running the crawler's custom JavaScript in Screaming Frog's List mode on a few chosen URLs and reviewing the generated alt text, instead of crawling the whole site in Spider mode.
  <br><sub>`D2-C949` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (speaker not identified) · not in Google docs · Used by `DEV-IMG-02`</sub>

- **[Stage]** Because not every generated alt text can be checked by hand, a community speaker's safer script adds the page title to the LLM's image description, so the alt text carries the page's intent and not only what the image shows.
  <br><sub>`D2-C950` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (speaker not identified) · consistent with Google docs · [Google image SEO best practices](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/google-images) · Extends [D2-C537](D2-S13-using-images-to-your-advantage-and-engaging-search-users-with-videos.md) · Used by `DEV-IMG-02`</sub>

- **[Stage]** A community speaker named the limits of the title-based alt-text script: it rewrites only the hero image, assumes the page title states the user's intent, had been tested in only one language or market, and runs on the free Gemini model.
  <br><sub>`D2-C951` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (speaker not identified)</sub>

- **[Stage]** A community speaker warned that articles still recommend rewriting alt text with AI, called AI a tool, and said that adopting such new AI implementations without applying existing SEO knowledge can damage ranking performance.
  <br><sub>`D2-C952` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (speaker not identified) · Extends [D2-C462](D2-S12-what-is-structured-data-and-why-we-need-it-on-the-internet.md)</sub>

- **[Stage]** A community talk described 'prompt journalism' as journalistic and content work, such as interviews and podcasts, done with a prompt-assisted workflow whose aim is to optimize material already recorded, which holds expertise, quotes and context, rather than to create more content.
  <br><sub>`D2-C953` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (Patrick Domanico) · Used by the glossary term *Prompt journalism*</sub>

- **[Stage]** The first step of a community speaker's prompt-assisted workflow is cleaning the interview transcript of fillers, a step that needs editorial and SEO judgment because a published page is read by many systems whose way of consuming it is unknown.
  <br><sub>`D2-C954` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (Patrick Domanico)</sub>

- **[Stage]** A community speaker cited W3C guidance that, when cleaning a transcript, it is usually not appropriate to correct the speaker's grammar or other mistakes.
  <br><sub>`D2-C955` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (Patrick Domanico) · not in Google docs</sub>

- **[Stage]** In the mapping step of a prompt-assisted workflow, an AI system splits an interview transcript into chapters with timestamps, headings and entities; in a community speaker's example it correctly extracted the subsea cables 2Africa and Equiano from a passage on Internet infrastructure in Africa.
  <br><sub>`D2-C956` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (Patrick Domanico)</sub>

- **[Stage]** A community speaker said the chapters and entities extracted from an interview transcript can then be used to generate metadata and structured data for the published content.
  <br><sub>`D2-C957` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (Patrick Domanico)</sub>

- **[Stage]** The second step of the prompt-assisted workflow applies the newsroom's inverted pyramid (the five Ws and H first, then attribution and quotes, context and secondary text); because it is a fixed structure, it can be written as a prompt that generates the article.
  <br><sub>`D2-C958` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (Patrick Domanico)</sub>

- **[Stage]** From one unified interview transcript, a community speaker's workflow produces a full article for the website and shorter angles for LinkedIn, Substack, X and YouTube.
  <br><sub>`D2-C959` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (Patrick Domanico)</sub>

- **[Stage]** A community speaker said publishers can also verify their social accounts in Search Console, which makes it easier to track the performance of content repurposed for social platforms.
  <br><sub>`D2-C960` · Day 2, Lightning session F: Media (Patrick Domanico) · confirmed by Google docs · [Analyze your social and video platform content performance in Search Console](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/monitor-debug/analyze-social-video-content) · Extended by [D3-C442](D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) · Extended by [D3-C468](D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) · Used by `DEV-MON-09`</sub>
